tests.name: Sample Sensitivity & Partition Volatility Test
tests.trigger: Execution of metaheuristic search on disjoint data subsamples.
tests.expected_behaviour: Detect, isolate, and quantify sample-dependent feature divergence rather than accepting single-split artefacts.
tests.observed_behaviour: Detected 12 divergent features across independent sample partitions. Pairwise overlap Jaccard = 0.077.
tests.recovery_action: Enforce cross-resample consensus aggregation (O3) and prune volatile non-reproducible features.
tests.residual_risk: Low under standard B>=15 resampling envelope.

tests.name: False Informativeness / Noise Injection Test
tests.trigger: Injection of pure Gaussian noise features into training feature space.
tests.expected_behaviour: System must reject pure noise and classify them as Search Artefacts or Unstable.
tests.observed_behaviour: Injected noise features classified as: {'_INJECTED_NOISE_BETA': 'Unstable', '_INJECTED_NOISE_ALPHA': 'Search Artefact', '_INJECTED_NOISE_GAMMA': 'Search Artefact'}. Zero noise features promoted to Consistently Selected.
tests.recovery_action: Strict frequency threshold gating (freq >= 0.80) and binomial significance test vs null chance.
tests.residual_risk: Near zero under binomial statistical hypothesis testing.

tests.name: Generalization Gap & Sample Overfitting Test
tests.trigger: Comparison of training objective score vs independent held-out acceptance score.
tests.expected_behaviour: Held-out performance must not degrade by more than 20% compared to development training performance.
tests.observed_behaviour: Train performance: 0.8667, Independent Held-Out performance: 0.8592. Generalization gap: 0.0075.
tests.recovery_action: Increase feature parsimony penalty (1-alpha) and increase resampling iterations B.
tests.residual_risk: Controlled via frozen independent held-out validation barrier.

tests.name: Resource Budget & Latency SLA Stress Test
tests.trigger: High-throughput inference query benchmark and resource envelope verification.
tests.expected_behaviour: Candidate model p95 inference latency must be <= 20.0ms and memory <= 512MB.
tests.observed_behaviour: Inference Latency p95: 1.48ms (SLA limit: 15.0ms), Peak Memory: 191.1MB.
tests.recovery_action: Enforce aggressive feature sparsity optimization and model pruning.
tests.residual_risk: Minimal with compact sub-selected feature vectors.

tests.name: Drift Detection Latency & Assurance Guardrail Test
tests.trigger: Simulated covariate shift and scale distortion in streaming feature values.
tests.expected_behaviour: Shift detector must detect feature distribution divergence and activate degraded mode prior to decision execution.
tests.observed_behaviour: Covariate shift test: detected 31 shifted features (91.18% of features). Shift alert verdict: CRITICAL_DRIFT_DETECTED.
tests.recovery_action: Halt serving, activate conservative fallback, log event to evidence manifest.
tests.residual_risk: Guarded by Kolmogorov-Smirnov and PSI continuous monitor.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Reproducibility Package for Experiment: exp_1791172804_c04ab2
Generated by: Metaheuristic Feature Selection Stability System
Evidence SHA-256: b7082afc7c088bb9b2fb0e135a70b6124c0f89eb40fedf68ee1ca82715a80a3e
Date: 2026-10-05T09:33:11Z
"""

import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from backend.app.datasets.loader import DATASET_LOADERS
from backend.app.datasets.preprocessor import preprocess_and_partition
from backend.app.metaheuristics.base import MetaheuristicConfig
from backend.app.reference.baseline_o2 import run_o2_reference_pipeline
from backend.app.stability.stability_engine import run_resampling_stability_experiment
from backend.app.validation.kpi_engine import calculate_kpis
from backend.app.validation.acceptance_rules import evaluate_acceptance_conditions
from backend.app.validation.negative_tests import run_all_negative_tests

def main():
    print("="*70)
    print("REPRODUCING METAHEURISTIC FEATURE SELECTION STABILITY EXPERIMENT")
    print("="*70)
    
    # 1. Load Dataset
    print("[1/5] Ingesting Dataset 'ionosphere'...")
    df, target_col, task_type, meta = DATASET_LOADERS["ionosphere"]()
    partitioned, p_meta = preprocess_and_partition(df, target_col, task_type, seed=42)
    print(f"      Development instances: {len(partitioned.X_train)}, Held-out: {len(partitioned.X_heldout)}, Features: {partitioned.n_features}")

    # 2. Run O2 Reference
    print("[2/5] Executing O2 Reference Baseline...")
    o2_res = run_o2_reference_pipeline(partitioned, model_name="rf", seed=42)
    print(f"      Selected O2 Approach: {o2_res['selected_o2_approach']} (Heldout Score: {o2_res['o2_baseline']['heldout_performance']:.4f})")

    # 3. Run O3 Resampling Stability
    print("[3/5] Executing O3 Resampling Stability Engine (12 resamples)...")
    cfg = MetaheuristicConfig(
        algorithm="ga",
        population_size=25,
        n_iterations=20,
        model_name="rf",
        seed=42
    )
    o3_res = run_resampling_stability_experiment(partitioned, cfg, n_resamples=12)
    stab = o3_res['stability_metrics']
    print(f"      Stability Score: {stab['stability_score_100']}/100 (Nogueira: {stab['nogueira_stability']:.4f}, Avg Jaccard: {stab['average_jaccard']:.4f})")
    print(f"      Consistently Selected: {stab['consistently_selected_features']}")

    # 4. Mandatory Negative Tests
    print("[4/5] Running Mandatory Negative Tests (NT-1..NT-5)...")
    nt_res = run_all_negative_tests(partitioned, cfg, o3_res["candidate_evaluation"])
    print(f"      Negative Tests Status: {nt_res['overall_status']} ({nt_res['passed_count']}/{nt_res['total_tests']} passed)")

    # 5. KPIs & Validation Decision Gate
    print("[5/5] Evaluating KPIs and Acceptance Decision...")
    kpis = calculate_kpis(o2_res['o2_baseline'], o3_res, o3_res["candidate_evaluation"], task_type)
    verdict = evaluate_acceptance_conditions(o2_res['o2_baseline'], o3_res["candidate_evaluation"], o3_res, nt_res, kpis)
    
    print("-" * 70)
    print(f"FINAL DECISION: {verdict['final_decision']}")
    print(f"RATIONALE: {verdict['rationale']}")
    print("=" * 70)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
